rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese way to say that something happens once every week.

example.english: I go to the wet market weekly.
example.traditional: 我每個星期都去一次街市。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 heoi3 jat1 ci3 gaai1 si5

rows.jyutping: mui5 sing1 kei4 jat1 ci3 ge3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose attributive phrase for something that happens once every week, such as a weekly check-up.

example.traditional: 我個每星期一次嘅覆診改咗期。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 mui5 sing1 kei4 jat1 ci3 ge3 fuk1 can2 goi2 zo2 kei4
